name: Oregon DSL Submerged Lands Enhancement Fund
summary: Biennial grants for projects that restore, enhance or protect the beds and banks of Oregon-owned waterways, including fish and wildlife habitat, water quality and removal of derelict structures and marine debris. Nonprofits, watershed councils, Tribes and public bodies can apply, with a 25% match.

calls.label: 2025-27 grant cycle
calls.note: The funder says applications for 2027-29 will be announced later; no date is stated.

status.quote: Applications for the 2025-27 grant cycle closed on April 30, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: State agencies, city or county governments, federally recognized Tribes, water improvement districts, watershed councils, park and recreation districts, ports, and non-profit organizations.

geography.quote: Projects that enhance the beds and banks of Oregon-owned waterways often benefit water quality, surrounding wildlife, and waterway users.

access.quote: Subscribe to our "Waterways and Wetlands" list to be notified when applications open for 2027-29!

co_finance_required.quote: A 25% funding match is required for all projects not initiated by DSL (in-kind or cash).
